instruction: Action photograph of two martial artists sparring in a bright room with white walls and a concrete floor. In the foreground, a bearded man with a headband (R6) in a black gi stands with his back partially to the camera in a fighting stance. Facing him in the background, a teenager with dark hair (R5) in a black gi and brown belt maintains a defensive pose with a slight smile. Natural light streams from a side window, casting soft shadows across the floor.
